narrative.intro: Stonex Financial has $144M in federal contract obligations in FY27 to date. Stonex Financial received 18 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $8M. Stonex Financial obligations are down 88.8% year over year. Stonex Financial saw larger obligations in prior years: $1.7B in FY22, $1.7B in FY23, $703M in FY24, $1.3B in FY25, and $1.3B in FY26. Stonex Financial current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is ongoing. Stonex Financial award-value tables and expiring-contracts tables use total contract values rather than obligations, while the headline figures here are contract obligations. Stonex Financial performance this fiscal year is a sharp decline from the $1.3B level recorded in both FY25 and FY26. Stonex Financial stakeholders should note that the FY27 snapshot reflects fiscal year to date activity, and full-year totals may change as the year progresses.

sections.heading: What is Stonex Financial's current federal contracting status?
sections.body: Stonex Financial has $144M in obligations in FY27 to date and 18 awards so far. Stonex Financial average award size is $8M. Stonex Financial obligations are down 88.8% year over year, reflecting reduced spending through the fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: How has Stonex Financial's federal business trended over recent years?
sections.body: Stonex Financial obligations were $1.7B in FY22 and $1.7B in FY23. Stonex Financial obligations fell to $703M in FY24, then rose to $1.3B in FY25 and $1.3B in FY26, before falling to $144M in FY27 to date. Stonex Financial year-over-year change for the current fiscal year is down 88.8%.
